Comics.2516442017792: I'm looking for this woman, have you seen her?

Dialogue.369680622859923456:
I can't believe you're doing this, Alice. It's not real. It's not! It's all in your head. We can work this out if you just calm the fuck down! I don't want to hear about it. 
None of this makes any sense! I don't understand a single fucking thing of what you're saying! Jesus Christ, will you calm down? I
Dialogue.369680622897672192:
Why don't you listen to me? I'm telling you it's real, I'm not making this up! I can't do this, don't you get it? He'll kill us both! It was a mistake saying anything, I get that. 
I should have just left. I thought you'd understand, I really did. How stupid am I? This was all a mistake from the beginning. Will you stop the car? Stop the car!
Dialogue.369680622918643712: I want to show you something. It’s up there, on the peak.
Dialogue.369680622943809536: Imagine finding a girl like you in a place like this.
Dialogue.369680622948003840: Oh honey. He won't let me leave.
Dialogue.369680622956392448: Alice Baker isn't in right now.
Dialogue.369680622960586753: Of course, that's what friends are for.
Dialogue.369680622960586754: Why don't you come upstairs? Have a look around.
Dialogue.369680622968975361: Water’s coming in. Can’t you feel it?
Dialogue.369680622968975362: The only thing I feel is everything coming apart.
Dialogue.369680622973169665: I don't know what to do. I'm not a killer.
Dialogue.369680622977363970: Just tell me something that makes sense!
Dialogue.369680622981558275: ...This is it then.. Too late to stop now.
Dialogue.369680622985752576: You’re not an officer. What are you up to, trespassing in the Sheriff’s department?
Dialogue.369680622985752577: Deputy Roberts invited me. I’m looking for Eddie Velvet.
Dialogue.369680622989946880: I’m a private investigator. I’m just out here trying to do my job.
Dialogue.369680622989946881: Is that so? When you find Eddie, what are you going to tell him? Think you’ll have a lot to talk about?
Dialogue.369680622994141185: I have a license to carry.
Dialogue.369680622994141186: Don’t make any sudden moves. Keep your hands where I can see them.
Dialogue.369680622994141188: Oh, you’d like that, wouldn’t you? That’s what you really want. Getting thrown on the ground, face against the gravel.
Dialogue.369680622994141189: You want my boot on your neck pushing you down until you hear bone crunch.
Dialogue.369680622994141190: I’m not done with you, son. I’m just getting started. I’ll be watching you.
Dialogue.369680623002529793: I've got my eye on you.
Dialogue.369680623027695616: "[wordlessly humming ""O when the saints go marching in""]"
Dialogue.369680623031889920: O Lord, I want to be among the number When the saints go marching in...
Dialogue.369680623036084226: Sorry to bother you. Is everything all right?
Dialogue.369680623044472832: Why wouldn't it be? Leave me alone.
Dialogue.369680623044472835: I wasn't aware. I thought the entire building was condemned.
Dialogue.369680623048667136: Don’t play with me. I know you’re up to no good.
Dialogue.369680623048667137: """I don't feel like myself anymore"", you some sort of schizoid, son? Some sort of freak?"
Dialogue.369680623048667139: You're up to something. You’re dirty.
Dialogue.369680623052861440: I’m gonna find out and when I do, I'll make you pay.
Dialogue.369680623057055744: I’m just looking for Eddie Velvet. I don’t care what you think. I have a job to do, and right now you’re in my way.
Dialogue.369680623057055745: Yeah? And then what? Huh? Are you gonna get angry?
Dialogue.369680623061250048: I can’t wait for you to make a move, son.
Dialogue.369680623061250050: You’re in so much shit and there’s really no way out, is there?
Dialogue.369680623065444352: Get the fuck out of my face.
Dialogue.369680623069638656: """In your anger do not sin: Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry, and do not give the devil a foothold."""
Dialogue.369680623069638657: You’re not a religious man, are you?
Dialogue.369680623073832961: What’s your problem? What do you want?
Dialogue.369680623073832962: I want you out of Silver Pines.
Dialogue.369680623078027264: Well. I’m not leaving until I find Eddie Velvet.
Dialogue.369680623078027265: That’s it, isn’t it? That’s why you’ve been breathing down my neck ever since I got here.
Dialogue.369680623078027268: You don’t know how to find him, so you’re making me do all the leg work.
Dialogue.369680623086415873: Think you’ll be able to take him off my hands, old man? You think you’ve got what it takes?
Dialogue.369680623086415875: I want you out of this town.
Dialogue.369680623090610176: I don't care what you think.
Dialogue.369680623094804480: I figured you'd wind up down here. Is it that you like the smell of the sewer so much?
Dialogue.369680623094804481: The point of no return is closing in. You've lost it. Turn back.
Dialogue.369680623094804482: I've got nothing to say to you.
Dialogue.369680623098998785: Just turn back. Even a deviant like yourself can have a peaceful life if you keep your head down.
Dialogue.369680623103193088: You got something you wanna do, just do it already, old man. I'm sick of your hollow threats, you're not scaring me.
Dialogue.369680623103193089: Careful now son, real careful. Any further than this and the gloves come off.
Dialogue.369680623107387392: You’re really asking for it, aren’t you?
Dialogue.369680623107387393: After this the gloves come off.
Dialogue.369680623136747520: I’m starting to think you’re not getting the message. I don’t want you here.
Dialogue.369680623140941824: Oh, I’ve picked up on that.
Dialogue.369680623140941825: I don’t think you have. Let me put it in terms you might understand. If you take one more step, I’ll be your last. Is that clear enough for you?
Dialogue.369680623140941826: I couldn’t go back even if I wanted to. I’m not leaving without Eddie Velvet.
Dialogue.369680623140941827: And I sure as shit won’t be giving him up to you.
Dialogue.369680623145136129: All right then. Let’s see what you’ve got.
Dialogue.369680623145136131: What are you talking about? You really want to do this?
Dialogue.369680623149330432: Go on, do it. Do it.
Dialogue.369680623199662082: I’ve got at least a hundred pounds on you.
Dialogue.369680623203856384: Let’s see how long you last.
Dialogue.369680623216439296: You don’t know when to quit, do you?
Dialogue.369680623224827904: You got me, son. You got me good.
Dialogue.369680623224827907: Why? Why did you get in my way?
Dialogue.369680623229022209: What was the point of all of this?
Dialogue.369680623233216513: I feel so much better now.
Dialogue.369680623237410816: Are you okay? What happened to your hands?
Dialogue.369680623237410817: Can you smell it? The smoke. I burned it all.
Dialogue.369680623237410819: I had to. I had to get rid of everything. It was the only way to make him leave me alone.
Dialogue.369680623241605120: It's bittersweet. I can feel something coming to an end. I know he won't be coming back now.
Dialogue.369680623241605122: Not anymore. He used to be, the little man. But it wasn't really me he was after.
Dialogue.369680623241605123: It was all those things that I was hanging on to...
Dialogue.369680623245799424: Look, it isn't safe to be out here.
Dialogue.369680623245799425: It doesn't matter anymore. Everything is going to be all right.
Dialogue.369680623245799426: The little man will find you soon enough.
Dialogue.369680623275159553: What do you mean? I'm already free.
Dialogue.369680623275159554: No, you're not. You don't even know what's holding you back.
Dialogue.369680623275159555: All the trinkets you're carrying around, bits and pieces you think are important, but really they're weighing you down.
Dialogue.369680623279353856: Come back when you've gathered all of them and we'll burn them together.
Dialogue.369680623300325376: You've destroyed everything you own, and it's made you free?
Dialogue.369680623308713984: It's not just about the things themselves, it's what they represent.
Dialogue.369680623308713985: It's eveything that goes along with them.
Dialogue.369680623308713986: Now, anything is possible, nothing is holding me back. A clean slate.
Dialogue.369680623308713987: You can do the same thing. I can help you.
Dialogue.369680623312908288: It's only when you know what you're getting rid of that you can truly let go.
Dialogue.369680623312908289: Bring the things you cling on to, and burn it all at once.
Dialogue.369680623317102592: You're well on your way. You're getting closer.
Dialogue.369680623317102593: Once you have all of your things gathered up, come see me again. We'll burn everything, and you'll be free like me.
Dialogue.369680623317102595: I'm offering something few people ever get to experience.
Dialogue.369680623325491200: You'll be like a child seeing the world for the very first time.
Dialogue.369680623346462720: Why would that be any better?
Dialogue.369680623346462721: It can be whatever you make of it. You'll make your own future.
Dialogue.369680623346462722: No reason to worry about tomorrow.
Dialogue.369680623346462723: Just being truly present in the moment, and then see where it takes you.
Dialogue.369680623350657024: Just a few more trinkets, and you can be free like me.
Dialogue.369680623350657025: Gather them all, and we'll set you free.
Dialogue.369680623359045632: You did it. You found all the things that were dragging you down.
Dialogue.369680623359045633: Now it's time to let go of them.
Dialogue.369680623359045634: I don't know if I can.
Dialogue.369680623359045635: Yes you can. You've been clinging to this stuff like it's your last breath, and its tearing you apart.
Dialogue.369680623359045636: Let go. It will set you free.
Dialogue.369680623363239937: They were not really yours to begin with. You borrowed them.
Dialogue.369680623363239938: Why destroy them? Won't I just be worse off than I am now?
Dialogue.369680623363239939: Letting go is important in all things. It's how you live, how you grow and how you die.
Dialogue.369680623367434240: The end matters just as much as the beginning. Or you won't have lived at all.
Dialogue.369680623367434241: Put them in the furnace. The fire will take care of the rest.
Dialogue.369680623367434242: Put your little trinkets in the fire and you'll be free.
Dialogue.369680623388405760: Go on, put them in the fire.
Dialogue.369680623396794369: You didn’t see the sign? Don’t worry, have a drink. On the house.
Dialogue.369680623400988673: It's the strangest thing. I feel like I'm dreaming.
Dialogue.369680623400988675: It's going to sound crazy. I don't remember coming to this place. I thought I was somewhere else.
Dialogue.369680623405182976: Like you were dreaming, and that you just woke up.
Dialogue.369680623405182977: What's to say you're not dreaming now?
Dialogue.369680623409377280: That's your business, not mine. But you should know that there's no turning back.
Dialogue.369680623409377282: You’ve got to finish what you started.
Dialogue.369680623409377283: It's like a wild horse. You either ride it, or it rides you.
Dialogue.369680623409377284: You’ll be fine. Just stay cool, and keep your head above the water.
Dialogue.369680623409377285: Now, why don’t you take a seat and stretch your legs for a bit.
Dialogue.369680623413571584: The show is just about to start. Eddie Velvet is playing. I know you don’t want to miss that.
Dialogue.369680623413571585: Take a seat and put your feet up.
Dialogue.369680623421960192: I’ll be seeing you down the road, partner.
Dialogue.369680623421960193: Good to see you again, partner.
Dialogue.369680623426154496: You were at the Rabbit Hole.
Dialogue.369680623426154499: I’m not one to look the other way when someone is in a bad spot.
Dialogue.369680623430348801: It's a dark night and it wants to eat you alive.
Dialogue.369680623430348803: Don't worry. I’ve got your back.
Dialogue.369680623430348804: What do you mean? You'll help me?
Dialogue.369680623430348805: That's right. I don’t know what’s happening here, and I don’t need to know.
Dialogue.369680623434543104: We shoot first and ask questions later. I’ll work my end and you’ll work yours.
Dialogue.369680623434543105: Does that sound about right to you?
Dialogue.369680623438737408: Right now I could use all the help I can get. I can't tell you how much I appreciate your support.
Dialogue.369680623438737410: It's like I'm stuck in a nightmare and I don't know how to wake up.
Dialogue.369680623442931712: There now. We'll figure this out. Sure, it's grim out there but you'll come out on top. I'll make sure of it.
Dialogue.369680623442931713: I've got something for you. See it as a token of good luck. Hope you get some use out of it.
Dialogue.369680623442931714: Maybe our paths will cross later on. It’s a good night for riding, don’t you think?
Dialogue.369680623447126017: Didn’t mean to let you down, partner.
Dialogue.369680623447126019: This is as far as I go.
Dialogue.369680623455514624: You're going to have to finish this on your own.
Dialogue.369680623455514626: It's all connected to him somehow.  I just don't know how.
Dialogue.369680623455514627: Well, I think you know everything you need to know.
Dialogue.369680623455514628: You have to put him down.
Dialogue.369680623459708928: No second thoughts. There's no room for that.
Dialogue.369680623459708929: It's the only way to end to all of this.
Dialogue.369680623459708930: I'll just rest here for a bit. I'd do more if I could, but I don't think I have it in me.
Dialogue.369680623493263360: I thought you were dead. I saw you... What happened?
Dialogue.369680623493263361: This place is not always what it seems to be. I figure you've guessed as much by now.
Dialogue.369680623501651968: I don't know what to expect anymore.
Dialogue.369680623501651969: Everything comes to an end, and yours is just up ahead. Are you ready for a final rodeo?
Dialogue.369680623501651970: After that, it's time for the happy forever after.
Dialogue.369680623501651971: I don't know if I'm ready. Do you think it'll be all right?
Dialogue.369680623501651972: You've made someone very angry, so you'll have to deal with that as best you can.
Dialogue.369680623501651973: Don't be scared. It all comes full circle in the end.
Dialogue.369680623505846272: That's everyting one can hope for.
Dialogue.369680623535206400: Take a breath, get yourself ready. Then it's time to step on out. They're waiting for you.
Dialogue.369680623535206402: You'll have to find that out yourself.
Dialogue.369680623535206403: I've done my bit, small as it was. Now it's all up to you.
Dialogue.369680623589732352: I'm pretty sure this is the spot.
Dialogue.369680623589732355: You're digging a hole. Must be looking for something?
Dialogue.369680623589732356: It's not that kind of hole.
Dialogue.369680623589732357: It's dangerous out here, are you sure this is a good idea?
Dialogue.369680623593926656: It's fine. I have to do this. Everything will be all right once I'm done.
Dialogue.369680623593926657: Got a bit further to go before I'm done.
Dialogue.369680623598120960: It's heavy work, but it'll be worth it.
Dialogue.369680623606509571: If there's nothing down there, why are you digging? It doesn't make any sense.
Dialogue.369680623606509572: Don't mean to be rude, but I've got a lot of work to do. This hole ain't gonna dig itself, if you get my meaning.
Dialogue.369680623610703872: I just have to. There's no other way of putting it. Now if you'll excuse me...
Dialogue.369680623614898177: It's starting to get the right size to it now, don't you think?
Dialogue.369680623623286784: Yeah I guess. I can barely see you down there. How are you planning on getting up again?
Dialogue.369680623623286786: What would be the point of that?
Dialogue.369680623623286787: So you'll just be stuck down there?
Dialogue.369680623627481088: Not forever. Sooner or later the walls will cave in and I'll have a couple of tonnes of dirt on top of me.
Dialogue.369680623627481089: Mostly clay, very acidic. No oxygen. A perfect preservative. I'll be fine.
Dialogue.369680623627481090: Christ. This is insane. Just stop it already, I'll help you up.
Dialogue.369680623631675392: No thanks. You're not seeing the big picture.
Dialogue.369680623631675393: I don't think you'd ever understand, so just take my word for it. It's better down here.
Dialogue.369680623631675394: I'm happier now than I've ever been.
Dialogue.369680623635869696: I'm right where I'm supposed to be.
Dialogue.369680623648452609: Eddie Velvet. It’s his last gig.
Dialogue.369680623648452611: I know the words to all of his songs.
Dialogue.369680623652646912: It'll be the kind of moment that lasts forever.
Dialogue.369680623652646913: I guess you’re his biggest fan.
Dialogue.369680623656841217: But I know him better than he knows himself.
Dialogue.369680623656841218: The show is about to start.
Dialogue.369680623656841219: I wouldn't want to miss this for the world.
Dialogue.369680623665229824: The cable car won't run without the bells.
Dialogue.369680623665229826: It won't run without the bells.
Dialogue.369680623669424128: What do you mean? It's not working?
Dialogue.369680623669424129: It's working just fine. It just won't run without the bells.
Dialogue.369680623673618432: It's my job, you know. I make sure it runs just fine. But not without the bells.
Dialogue.369680623673618433: What happened to the bells then?
Dialogue.369680623673618434: Someone's always messing with them. Maybe someone who doesn't want you to see what's up on that peak.
Dialogue.369680623673618435: I'm looking for Eddie Velvet. Is here up there?
Dialogue.369680623677812736: I couldn't say. Wouldn't surprise me, he's been there before. He and his lady friend.
Dialogue.369680623677812738: I shouldn't say anything more, not with everything that happened. It's with the sheriff now, that's all I know. They'll sort it out.
Dialogue.369680623682007040: Haven't I seen you before? That bar, the Rabbit Hole?
Dialogue.369680623682007041: I loved to watch Eddie play. Music is what makes life worth living, don't you think?
Dialogue.369680623686201344: Until you've found the bells, the cable car won't run.
Dialogue.369680623686201345: This is the only way to get up to the peak.
Dialogue.369680623690395648: They killed him so he'd forget.
Dialogue.369680623694589952: His name. His size. His shape. Everything.
Dialogue.369680623694589953: Hello? They can't seem to hear me.
Dialogue.369680623698784256: Picked away at him, piece by piece. With enough gone, he lost himself.
Dialogue.369680623698784257: Nothing left but an empty shell.
Dialogue.369680623702978560: What am I doing here? What’s going on? I can’t make any sense of this place…
Dialogue.369680623707172865: Her name is Alice. Eddie thought he could win her over, get her to turn her back on everything she knew and loved. But it wasn’t that easy.
Dialogue.369680623707172867: Didn’t mean to startle you. Just thought you might want a helping hand.
Dialogue.369680623707172869: A sweetheart. The toast of the town. An angel, if you ask me.
Dialogue.369680623715561473: Well, she did have another side to her. But it only made her more beautiful.
Dialogue.369680623715561474: Sounds like you loved her. Did Eddie kill her?
Dialogue.369680623715561475: When you find him you can ask him that yourself. Ask him what gave him the right to come here and pull her away from us.
Dialogue.369680623715561476: Ask him if it was worth it.
Dialogue.369680623782670336: I’m glad you’ve gotten this far, detective. Honestly, I was beginning to worry you wouldn't make it.
Dialogue.369680623782670337: There was no other way. I don't have a choice.
Dialogue.369680623786864640: Alice was my world. A bright shining star on a black night sky.
Dialogue.369680623786864641: Now all that’s left for us is to rot until the end of time.
Dialogue.369680623786864642: Maybe you can’t bring Alice back to me, but killing Eddie is the next best thing.
Dialogue.369680623786864643: I'm not sure how I feel about that.
Dialogue.369680623795253248: I know you're not a killer, Walker. But to Eddie, you're an angel of mercy.
Dialogue.369680623795253249: I’m glad it’ll be you. It’s just the way it was always supposed to be.
Dialogue.369680623799447552: Put him out of his misery.
Dialogue.369680623824613376: Look at her. Look at what he did to my sweet girl...
Dialogue.369680623828807680: I'm sorry. You must have loved her very much.
Dialogue.369680623828807681: Eddie is still alive. And you want to offer condolences?
Dialogue.369680623828807682: Killing Eddie won’t bring her back.
Dialogue.369680623828807683: You’d rather rot here in Silver Pines? You couldn’t do the one thing, the only thing, that would get you out here? You’re weak. Pathetic.
Dialogue.369680623833001984: I’m not going to run your errands. You want him dead so much, why don’t you do it yourself?
Dialogue.369680623833001985: It has to be you! You have to kill him!
Dialogue.369680623833001986: I’m done here. Whatever your game is, I don’t want to have any part of it.
Dialogue.369680623862362112: Go back, finish what you started.
Dialogue.369680623883333632: It's not too late to do the right thing.
Dialogue.369680623904305152: Where do you think you're going?
Dialogue.369680623912693760: I'm leaving. I told you, I'm done with this.
Dialogue.369680623912693761: There's nothing for you out there.
Dialogue.369680623912693762: I can't let you go. You're staying here. With me.
Dialogue.369680623912693763: I don't think so. You'll have to stop me.
Dialogue.369680623963025408: Useless pile of shit...I hate you.
Dialogue.369680624055300097: Thank you for calling. I've been expecting you.
Dialogue.369680624055300098: I'm sorry? This is my first time calling here.
Dialogue.369680624059494400: Your call didn't begin when you dialed the number on the phone. It began when you decided you had nowhere else to go.
Dialogue.369680624059494402: "While you're asking that, something else is happening. But no rush. It's ""the kind of moment that lasts forever"", right?"
Dialogue.369680624067883008: Why did you turn back? I don’t understand…
Dialogue.369680624067883010: Everything was going to be great for us. I had it all figured out. We’d escape together, no one would ever find us.
Dialogue.369680624067883012: I fucked up. It’s over. There’s no point anymore.
Dialogue.369680624072077313: Look at you. Look what I did to you. You told me but I didn’t listen. I never listen. It was never the town, it was me.
Dialogue.369680624076271616: I was the worst thing that could have happened to you. I’m the nightmare.
Dialogue.369680624076271617: I’m done. Please make it stop. I just want this to stop.
Dialogue.369680624076271618: I want this to be over.
Dialogue.369680624076271619: What did you do, Eddie? Did you kill the girl?
Dialogue.369680624080465920: You would still be alive if you hadn't met me.
Dialogue.369680624080465923: I want it to be over.
Dialogue.369680624109826048: Sorry Eddie. There was no other way...
Dialogue.369680624193712128: It's just rain, we've heard all this before!
Dialogue.369680624193712129: If the levees fail then it'll be even worse than back in '44!
Dialogue.369680624193712130: What about the Baker girl, she's still missing. Why was the search called off?
Dialogue.369680624193712131: We don't need to search! It's that damn musician! Look at him!
Dialogue.369680624193712132: I already told the sheriff I had nothing to do with that. Fuck you!
Dialogue.369680624193712133: Is she up there? Did you hide her up on the peak? Just tell us where the she is!
Dialogue.369680624202100736: Surprised to see anyone still outside. Most people are holed up somewhere high and dry or they’ve skipped town.
Dialogue.369680624202100737: So I keep hearing. I’m looking for a musician called Eddie Velvet.
Dialogue.369680624202100738: Don’t know him. But he must be someone very important to you, to be braving this kind of weather.
Dialogue.369680624202100739: Well, it’s my job. I find people.
Dialogue.369680624202100740: Even if the people you’re looking for don’t want to be found?
Dialogue.369680624202100741: Sorry, don’t mean to stick my nose where it doesn’t belong.
Dialogue.369680624210489344: I’m sure you have very good reasons to be doing what you’re doing.
Dialogue.369680624210489345: Is there a cable car service here in town?
Dialogue.369680624210489346: You planning on sight seeing? It's just north of here.
Dialogue.369680624210489347: It won't be easy getting there with so much of the town being closed off. But if it's important enough to you, I'm sure you'll manage.
Dialogue.369680624214683648: The cable car station is just north from here.
Dialogue.369680624214683649: Hope you find what you're looking for.
Dialogue.369680624223072256: I hear the storm's getting worse. Water is rising, the road's been eaten away.
Dialogue.369680624223072257: I wasn't leaving anyway. Not until I find Eddie.
Dialogue.369680624223072258: What is he to you anyway? If you're just chasing a paycheck there must be easier ways. Did he do something to you?
Dialogue.369680624227266560: No, no... It's more than that.
Dialogue.369680624231460864: I don't know how to say it.
Dialogue.369680624231460866: I need to find him... Like... If I don't... I just know something terrible will happen.
Dialogue.369680624231460867: Is that a feeling or do you know for sure?
Dialogue.369680624235655169: Chasing a man into the storm of a century over a feeling.
Dialogue.369680624235655171: I guess a feeling like that doesn't just come from nowhere. Just be careful where that takes you.
Dialogue.369680624239849472: My wife and I lived in this building back when everything was brand new. Modernity, here in Silver Pines!
Dialogue.369680624239849474: Do you think it's safe to go inside?
Dialogue.369680624244043776: If I say no, will that keep you?
Dialogue.369680624244043779: That place is crawling with bad memories. Still, memories can't hurt a man, can they?
Dialogue.369680624244043780: Lots of old memories in this place.
Dialogue.369680624252432384: Times have changed, the Union building is not what it used to be.
Dialogue.369680624256626688: Got what you came here for?
Dialogue.369680624256626689: Not yet. Don’t even know if I’m getting closer.
Dialogue.369680624256626691: I can't. I have to find Eddie Velvet.
Dialogue.369680624260820993: You're pursuing this goal as if your life depended on it, and you don’t know why?
Dialogue.369680624260820994: It’s just something I have to do.
Dialogue.369680624265015296: No one has to do anything except die, and in my view it’s better to put that off for as long as you can.
Dialogue.369680624265015297: You have an obsession. It's gonna end up killing you. And for what?
Dialogue.369680624269209600: You don't understand. I don't have a choice!
Dialogue.369680624269209602: There's no other way. I'm stuck, okay? I have to finish this.
Dialogue.369680624269209603: Maybe things aren't as bad as you think. Sure it's dark right now, but you're still in one piece more or less.
Dialogue.369680624269209604: You'll find a way, even if you don't see it now. Keep your eyes open.
Dialogue.369680624273403905: I believe in you. I think you'll get through whatever it is you're going through, and that everything will be all right.
Dialogue.369680624273403906: It's your life and your choice in how to spend it.
Dialogue.369680624281792512: You will know what is best for you.
Dialogue.369680624285986816: Did you find the man you were looking for?
Dialogue.369680624285986817: I did, but I... I couldn't go through with it. The job, I mean.
Dialogue.369680624285986818: Oh? So you had second thoughts?
Dialogue.369680624290181120: Something was off. I don't know.
Dialogue.369680624290181121: Trusting that feeling again. Sounds wise to me. It got you this far, didn't it? Might just take you all the way.
Dialogue.369680624294375424: There are still loose ends. I keep thinking there's more to this.
Dialogue.369680624294375425: Well, there you go. Maybe there is some hope after all. Sounds like you had a choice all along but you just didn't see it.
Dialogue.369680624294375426: That's the nature of things, the options aren't always laid out right in front of us.
Dialogue.369680624294375427: Like you said, I've come this far. If there's more to it, I'll find out.
Dialogue.369680624298569728: That's the spirit. Well, I wish you the best. It's been nice chatting.
Dialogue.369680624302764032: In case I don't see you again, good luck to you. I truly hope you'll find what you're looking for.
Dialogue.369680624315346944: I just got here. It’s been a long drive.
Dialogue.369680624315346945: The motel, Walker. You were going to the motel. The Crimson Bear.
Dialogue.369680624315346947: You still have the files on Eddie in the trunk of your car.
Dialogue.369680624319541248: Yeah. Yeah, I still have them.
Dialogue.369680624319541249: Focus. I’m paying you good money. Find him, Walker.
Dialogue.369680624319541250: Yeah, I’ll find him. I’ll find Eddie Velvet. I promise.
Dialogue.369680624323735553: I don't understand what's happening. There are things out here, horrible things...
Dialogue.369680624323735554: Don't do this to me, Walker. The job. I need you to focus on the job.
Dialogue.369680624323735555: There was a bar... I saw Eddie, he was with a girl.
Dialogue.369680624327929856: There was something else... "A Ride to the stars."
Dialogue.369680624327929858: Is there a cable car in town? I think Eddie and his girl were going up a mountain.
Dialogue.369680624327929859: Okay. Look into it. You're doing good, Walker. You're on the right track.
Dialogue.369680624332124160: Find out what you can. I want Velvet, that's all that matters.
Dialogue.369680624340512768: I think he went up to the peak. It’s a little hard to explain… What’s happening here?
Dialogue.369680624340512769: You’re doing great, Walker. You’re my eyes and ears. I trust you’re making the right calls. That’s why I hired you.
Dialogue.369680624340512770: Yeah, but what does any of this mean?
Dialogue.369680624340512771: Don’t worry about it. Just find Eddie for me, and you’ll be off to your paradise beach.
Dialogue.369680624344707073: When the job is done. Did you forget? Palm trees, the endless blue ocean, sipping a Piña Colada?
Dialogue.369680624344707075: You’ll have it made. Just go to the Peak, and bring me Eddie Velvet. All your troubles will melt away like a bad dream.
Dialogue.369680624348901376: What have you found out, detective?
Dialogue.369680624348901377: I checked out the sheriff's department. Eddie was a suspect in a missing person's case. There was an interview tape.
Dialogue.369680624353095680: Nothing concrete... The deputy was a bit... Difficult to work with. But I think I'm making progress in getting up on the peak.
Dialogue.369680624353095681: That should be your focus. Don't let yourself get distracted. Everything else is a sideshow. Keep me posted.
Dialogue.369680624357289984: There’s someone else out here. Old guy, he seems serious.
Dialogue.369680624357289985: Don’t let him get to Eddie first. If he does, our deal is off.
Dialogue.369680624357289986: Who is he? Is he looking for Eddie too?
Dialogue.369680624361484288: Probably just some asshole trying to make a quick buck. I’m sure you can handle him.
Dialogue.369680624361484289: I don’t know. I’m not doing too great…
Dialogue.369680624361484290: You’re not thinking of quitting on me, are you?
Dialogue.369680624361484291: What’s so important about Eddie Velvet anyway?
Dialogue.369680624365678593: Yeah? What are you going to do about it? What if I just get the hell out of here and disappear?
Dialogue.369680624369872896: You begged me for this assignment, remember?
Dialogue.369680624369872897: I'm doing you a favor here. And you're talking about backing out?
Dialogue.369680624374067200: We have a deal, Walker. You will uphold your end of the bargain. Is that clear?
Dialogue.369680624374067201: I’m sorry. I’m sorry Mr. Jackman.
Dialogue.369680624374067202: Do what you need to do to see this through. We won’t talk about this again. I’ll be in touch.
Dialogue.369680624378261504: I shot him. The old guy.
Dialogue.369680624378261505: Easy now. Tell me what happened.
Dialogue.369680624378261506: He was choking me. Like he was trying to kill me. I got a hold of his gun.
Dialogue.369680624378261507: Don't worry about it. No one will find out.
Dialogue.369680624382455808: There was something he said, he was talking about Eddie... I can't put my finger on it.
Dialogue.369680624382455809: Don't dwell on it. You'll have time to brood all you want once you've got a hold of Eddie for me.
Dialogue.369680624382455810: You acted in self defense, a man is dead, case closed. Any doubts or questions that you have are only going to slow you down.
Dialogue.369680624382455811: I'll try to let it go.
Dialogue.369680624386650112: Good man. You did the right thing. Be careful out there.
Dialogue.369680624390844416: Walker. I know you’ve gone through a lot to get here.
Dialogue.369680624390844417: I just want to wrap this up and go home.
Dialogue.369680624390844418: I understand. You’ll have earned it. Listen. I need you to push ahead. I’m not gonna sugar coat this, so I’ll just say it.
Dialogue.369680624395038720: Eddie is not leaving Silver Pines.
Dialogue.369680624395038721: He’s not? I thought that was the whole point. I find him and then I bring him back.
Dialogue.369680624395038722: When you find him, and I know you will, I need you to put an end to him. Finish him off.
Dialogue.369680624395038723: You want me to kill him.
Dialogue.369680624399233024: Don’t act surprised. You knew this was coming. Killing Eddie is your ticket out of there, detective. There’s no other way.
Dialogue.369680624399233025: I'm a private investigator, mr Jackman. Not an assassin.
Dialogue.369680624403427328: I think we both know that's not quite true, after everything that's happened.
Dialogue.369680624403427329: You’re in the deep end, Walker. You sink or you swim.
Dialogue.369680624411815939: Hey, you got the bad guy. That’s all there is to it.
Dialogue.369680624411815940: Don't beat yourself up, it’s not doing you any good.
Dialogue.369680624416010240: Just get in your car and head back home. You've earned some rest.
Dialogue.369680624416010241: Sunshine, palm trees and an endless blue ocean.
Dialogue.369680624416010242: I like the sound of that.
Dialogue.369680624416010243: Who knows, maybe there’s gonna be another assignment. I can use a dependable guy like you.
Dialogue.369680624420204544: I don’t know if I have it in me.
Dialogue.369680624420204545: Maybe you’ll feel different about it in the morning.
Dialogue.369680624420204546: You've got a bright future ahead of you, Walker.
Dialogue.369680624420204548: Walker? You don't sound so good.
Dialogue.369680624420204549: I'm fine, mr Jackman. A bit banged up is all.
Dialogue.369680624428593152: Sounds like an occupational hazard. You should patch yourself up, I can't have you croaking on me out there.
Dialogue.369680624428593153: You're my number one investment, Walker. I need you in one piece or you're no good to me.
Dialogue.369680624428593154: I'll try and be more careful.
Dialogue.369680624478924801: I thought I heard crying. Are you all right?
Dialogue.369680624478924802: I don’t think I should be talking to you. You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here either. This is all wrong.
Dialogue.369680624483119104: You’re right to be careful, it’s dangerous out here. Keep your door locked. I’m sorry to have disturbed you.
Dialogue.369680624483119105: You’re not safe either. I’ve seen what’s out there. I’ve seen the little man. He will tear you to pieces.
Dialogue.369680624487313408: Get out while you still can.
Dialogue.369680624487313409: I can’t leave. I have a job to do, I’m looking for his man…
Dialogue.369680624487313410: They’ll eat you alive. You won’t stand a chance.
Dialogue.369680624487313412: I’m sorry. I’m sorry you’re out there, doing all the things that you do. I’m sorry that I’m stuck in this room.
Dialogue.369680624487313413: I wish it was all different, but it isn’t.
Dialogue.369680624487313414: Just try to stay safe and everything will be all right.
Dialogue.369680624491507712: Wait. I have something for you.
Dialogue.369680624491507713: There’s a supply locker in the motel shop.  It’s no use to me but maybe it will help you. The code is 6671.
Dialogue.369680624495702016: He bit me in the neck.
Dialogue.369680624495702018: The man. The bad little man. He did other things too.
Dialogue.369680624504090624: He said he is going to eat me.
Dialogue.369680624504090625: He’s coming for you. Just like he came for that girl in the water.
Dialogue.369680624504090626: No one is getting out of here.
Dialogue.369680624508284928: What do you mean no one is getting out?
Dialogue.369680624508284929: I don't remember how I got here. Nothing makes any sense.
Dialogue.369680624508284930: There's a girl in the water and the little man won't leave her alone.
Dialogue.369680624508284931: He never lets anyone go. Not me, not you, not anyone.
Dialogue.369680624512479232: Who is the little man? What did he do?
Dialogue.369680624512479233: I wish I could just wake up.
Dialogue.369680624512479234: Why can't I just wake up?
Dialogue.369680624520867840: Do you think they'll ever find her?
Dialogue.369680624520867842: That missing girl. The one everyone's been looking for.
Dialogue.369680624525062144: Oh her... I'm sorry I don't know.
Dialogue.369680624525062145: She used to come here. Night after night.
Dialogue.369680624529256448: She knew the little man wouldn't let her leave. But she came here anyway. I don't think she was afraid of him.
Dialogue.369680624529256450: She never belonged to him. Maybe she wanted to... But it doesn't matter. It wasn't up to her.
Dialogue.369680624533450752: I'm still looking for Eddie. You haven't seem him have you?
Dialogue.369680624533450753: He wasn't able to do anything about it.
Dialogue.369680624533450754: In this place. He comes for everyone. There's no helping it.
Dialogue.369680624537645056: How did you get up here?
Dialogue.369680624537645057: I was going to stop it in time.
Dialogue.369680624541839361: But now I just don't... I just don't want to see what's inside. It’s too late anyway. There's no putting it back together.
Dialogue.369680624541839363: You need to get to shelter. It's not just the storm...
Dialogue.369680624541839364: You look just like him. I didn't see it at first.
Dialogue.369680624541839365: You're not here to help anyone. Not even yourself.
Dialogue.369680624546033664: I need to sit here for a while.
Dialogue.369680624554422275: Are you the man sneaking around outside my door?
Dialogue.369680624554422276: I thought I heard crying. Are you all right?
Dialogue.369680624554422277: Don’t worry. You have enough on your plate already, digging in the dirt, chasing shadows...
Dialogue.369680624554422278: In fact, I want to help you.
Dialogue.369680624558616577: There’s a supply locker in the store here at the motel.
Dialogue.369680624558616578: I'll give you the code, if you do something for me.
Dialogue.369680624558616579: And what do you want in return?
Dialogue.369680624567005184: I'd like you to have a drink with me. A nice bar, a quiet moment, just the two of us.
Dialogue.369680624567005185: A drink? Ma'm, I don't think it's safe to be going outside...
Dialogue.369680624567005186: Don't worry, it's you who needs to be careful. I can manage myself.
Dialogue.369680624567005187: The code is 6671. I'll catch you before we both finish our business.
Dialogue.369680624571199488: It'll be a nice way to wrap up the evening, don't you think?
Dialogue.369680624571199490: They can't seem to hear me...
Dialogue.369680624575393792: I knew you'd find my key. I watched you cross over.
Dialogue.369680624575393793: I understand you're busy chasing shadows, and that's the way it should be.
Dialogue.369680624575393794: I hope you remember the code, I'm still waiting for that drink.
Dialogue.369680624604753921: I remember you. We spoke on the phone. The motel.
Dialogue.369680624604753922: I was hoping you'd show up. Did you find what you were looking for?
Dialogue.369680624608948224: I don't think I'm quite done yet. I still have questions.
Dialogue.369680624608948225: You'll always have questions. There are lots of ways to skin a cat.
Dialogue.369680624613142529: Just water for me. I don't drink anymore.
Dialogue.369680624613142530: But you used to. Up on that stage, slurring the words by the end of a show.
Dialogue.369680624613142531: Looking out into the audience for any girls who looked young enough. Eager enough.
Dialogue.369680624617336832: I think you're confusing me with someone else.
Dialogue.369680624617336833: You'd fall into them hoping that something would happen, that you'd come alive even for a second and that some great purpose would reveal itself.
Dialogue.369680624617336835: It never worked, did it? Until she came along. Like a moth to a flame.
Dialogue.369680624621531136: Not sure who was the moth and who was the flame.
Dialogue.369680624621531137: Excuse me, but what the hell are you talking about? I'm Red Walker, I'm a private investigator.
Dialogue.369680624621531138: I don't blame you, darling. No one can know the future. We all try to guess it, and still get surprised by what was waiting for us.
Dialogue.369680624621531139: Like we didn't suspect what was coming, even though it should have been obvious from the start.
Dialogue.369680624625725440: How else can we live? If we knew all along what's in store for us, would we even bother with it?
Dialogue.369680624625725443: You stumble through it, like the rest of us. And that's all right.
Dialogue.369680624629919744: That's the way it should be.
Dialogue.369680624655085568: I'm happy we had this talk. Maybe something good will come out of it.
Dialogue.369680624655085569: You're saying I have to let go... of everything.
Dialogue.369680624655085570: There's no rush. You can stick around a little while longer if you wish. It won't hurt.
Dialogue.369680624659279874: What's going to happen to you?
Dialogue.369680624659279875: I'll be all right. I'm right where I'm supposed to be.
Dialogue.369680624709611521: Hello, uh, my name is Red Walker and I’m calling from Silver Pines.
Dialogue.369680624713805825: Can you hear me? My name is Red Walker.
Dialogue.369680624713805826: Hey Marie, can you hear anything here? Do you think there’s something wrong with this headset?
Dialogue.369680624713805827: I hear you, let me repeat…
Dialogue.369680624722194433: Hey, I just called but it seems like there was something wrong with the line.
Dialogue.369680624722194434: It’s the creepy prank caller again… Sir, you have to stop calling here, you are holding up the line for real emergencies.
Dialogue.369680624722194435: I will have to block this number.
Dialogue.369680624764137472: Hello, you’ve reached the tip line for CONMAG.
Dialogue.369680624764137473: We want to hear your story about the unexplained or the supernatural.
Dialogue.369680624764137474: ESP, UFO’s, government coverups, anything THEY wouldn’t want us to know about.
Dialogue.369680624772526080: Share your statement and contact information after the beep. We are listening.
Dialogue.369680624772526081: Hello, uh, my name is Red Walker and I’m calling from Silver Pines.
Dialogue.369680624772526082: I'm on a payphone, the number is 445555. There’s something very weird going on here.
Dialogue.369680624772526083: The town is empty of people but full of… things. I can’t quite explain it. You should come down here and see for yourself.
Dialogue.369680624801886208: Is this Red Walker? I’m calling from CONMAG regarding your recent tip.
Dialogue.369680624801886209: Yes! This is him, I mean that’s me. Thank god you called.
Dialogue.369680624801886210: Did you really say that you were in Silver Pines?
Dialogue.369680624801886211: Yes, that’s where I am, I’m on a payphone in town.
Dialogue.369680624801886212: Forgive me for sounding sceptical, but exactly how did you get there?
Dialogue.369680624810274816: I - uh, I guess I drove here, why?
Dialogue.369680624810274817: Yeah right, you drove there. Gimme a break man, is that supposed to be funny?
Dialogue.369680624810274818: We’re doing SERIOUS journalistic work here, we’re trying to get to the TRUTH, and people like you don’t make things any easier for us.
Dialogue.369680624810274819: Good bye sir, and a good night to you.
Dialogue.369680624814469120: The number you have dialed is not available.
Dialogue.369680624852217856: Mario’s, can I take your order?
Dialogue.369680624860606465: This is Dana at Mario’s pizza. Can I take your order please?
Dialogue.369680624864800769: Century street, Seattle. If you don’t want to order any food that’s fine, have a nice day sir.
Dialogue.369680624864800770: Wait! Maybe you can help me–
Dialogue.369680624864800771: You’re holding up the line, happy to take your order if you’ve changed your mind.
Dialogue.369680624864800772: Okay. Can I have a… Pepperoni Pizza?
Dialogue.369680624868995072: One pepperoni. And what’s the address?
Dialogue.369680624873189377: All signs point to the Crimson Bear Motel as Eddie Velvet's last location.
Dialogue.369680624873189378: Searching the Crimson Bear motel. I’ll find Eddie Velvet for you.
Dialogue.369680624873189379: Eddie was on a cable car. I'll try and retrace his steps.
Dialogue.369680624877383680: Still searching for Eddie. I won’t let you down.
Dialogue.369680624898355200: I'll find Eddie for you, Mr Jackman.
Dialogue.369680624944492544: Still searching. I won't let you down.
Dialogue.369680624948686849: I just arrived. Why do you ask?
Dialogue.369680624948686850: There’s an evacuation order in effect. Most people have left, I’m only here to make sure no one gets stranded.
Dialogue.369680624948686851: They say it’s going to be one hell of a storm.
Dialogue.369680624948686852: I’m looking for a guy called Eddie Velvet, have you seen him?
Dialogue.369680624952881152: Afraid not. Probably skipped town like every other sane person.
Dialogue.369680624952881153: Is he a friend of yours?
Dialogue.369680624952881154: Not exactly. I'm a private investigator. I need to find him for my client.
Dialogue.369680624957075456: Is that so? Well, I won't keep you. Just be careful, uh?
Dialogue.369680624961269760: I'm looking for a motel called the Crimson Bear. Do you know where that is?
Dialogue.369680624961269761: That's just through the tunnel up the road. You can't miss it.
Dialogue.369680624961269762: But you should really consider getting out of here while you still can. There could be flash floods, mudslides, you name it.
Dialogue.369680624965464064: Don’t want to have to pull you out of a flooded car if I can help it.
Dialogue.369680624965464065: I won’t cause you any trouble. Just trying to do my job.
Dialogue.369680624965464066: Well, best of luck out there. Have a good one.
Dialogue.369680624990629889: Do us all a favor, okay buddy?
Dialogue.369680624999018496: Go home, draw a hot bath, and slit your fucking wrists.
Dialogue.369680624999018499: You have a nice night now.
Dialogue.369680625003212801: No. I was attacked. There’s something horrible happening in this town.
Dialogue.369680625007407104: I… I don’t know how to describe it. It’s going to sound insane.
Dialogue.369680625007407108: Never mind. Forget I said anything.
Dialogue.369680625007407109: You sure? Do I have to worry about you?
Dialogue.369680625007407110: No, I’m fine. Probably just tired.
Dialogue.369680625007407111: You're not going crazy on me, are you, detective? Sounds to me like you need to slow down.
Dialogue.369680625015795712: Sounds to me like you should have listened to my advice and gotten the hell out of town.
Dialogue.369680625015795714: Just take it nice and slow.
Dialogue.369680625015795717: This is a restricted frequency. Who’s out there?
Dialogue.369680625024184320: Is this the deputy I saw on the ferry over?
Dialogue.369680625024184321: Detective Walker. Still in one piece huh? Why haven't you left yet?
Dialogue.369680625024184322: I’m still looking for Eddie Velvet. I'm following up on some leads that took me over to Riverside.
Dialogue.369680625024184323: You don't need to look any further detective. I think I've got what you want.
Dialogue.369680625024184324: Really? That's... You got him booked already? Why didn't you say so before?
Dialogue.369680625028378624: Oh... Must have slipped my mind. Probably best you just come on over, get this all sorted out.
Dialogue.369680625028378625: The code for the front door is: 17 15
Dialogue.369680625057738752: Roberts, what are you doing in there? Where's Eddie?
Dialogue.369680625057738753: Bad news, detective. Eddie’s not here.
Dialogue.369680625057738754: What do you mean he’s not here? You said you had him booked.
Dialogue.369680625057738755: I didn't say shit about having Eddie Locked up. That was you jumping to conclusions.
Dialogue.369680625057738757: BUT! I still got something that'll make your day.
Dialogue.369680625066127360: A taped interview between him and the Sheriff.
Dialogue.369680625066127361: You get this door open and the tape is yours, okay?
Dialogue.369680625066127362: What happened here, what happened to your face?
Dialogue.369680625070321664: You're the detective, what does it look like to you?
Dialogue.369680625070321665: Looks like a deputy locked up in his own interrogation room.
Dialogue.369680625070321667: That's fine, if you don't want to talk, I can just leave.

I dreamt I was laying in a field looking up at the night sky. No sounds, no wind, nothing but this vast empty space sprinkled with diamonds.
The Plough. Belt of Orion. Pisces. Then the stars started to move. I guess they’re always moving but so slowly that you can’t really see it. 
They were speeding up, drifting across the Milky Way creating new constellations. Some were pulled toward each other before being flung apart. One lit up in a flash and disappeared. 
I wasn’t on a field anymore, I was drifting in space, looking at dancing points of light moving all around me.
I realized that millions of years had passed and that Earth and everything on it was long gone. There was no going back, and all I could do was watch the universe play out the way it always would.
Eons passed as one by one the stars flickered out until all that remained were faintly glowing embers. Then the last lights faded out into perfect darkness and as they disappeared forever, so did I.

Lore.383818825291874304:
To all maintenance personnel:


During a previous event, failing to comply to safety rules lead to pressure buildup exceeding safe operating limits which caused a line to rupture to blow the door straight off its hinges. Luckily no one was hurt but maintenance had to spend 3 weeks patching it back up.
Lore.383818826696966144:
Any personnel working in or passing through this section are advised monitor the nearby pressure gauges and report irregular readings. For now, Lines A, B, and C remain shut off to reduce unexpected activity.


Do not tamper with valves, bypass safety locks, or attempt any unauthorized maintenance, and in the event of dangerous pressure levels, stand clear from the door.
Lore.384877066104946688:
Internal Record
Examiner: L. Ashbrook
Deceased: Jacob Foster, 68

Body is completely consumed by cancer. Frankly I don't understand how he was still walking around in the last few days before his passing. Extensive spread, severe wasting, several organs compromised.
Lore.384877067501649920: Truthfully, Father Foster should have passed much sooner. Whatever kept him alive, medicine had nothing to do with it. I saw strange things during my time in the jungle, but nothing like this. All I can say is that the old priest stayed alive through sheer will. Bizarre.
Lore.384888588164218880:
Took Alice to the beach again.

In spite of everything, water calms her down. For a long time I had figured it should trouble her, but near it she enters a quiet peace. We talk for hours, but I'm not reaching her. Something has changed. She's falling somewhere I cannot follow.
Lore.384888590018101248:
Ever since meeting the musician, her wounds are opening again. There is a distance in her now, a pull towards whatever stirs those old memories, and she takes it into her willingly.

I pray to the lord for the strength to keep helping her, yet my own will abandons me. I fear I was never strong enough to begin with. I fear I've failed her.
Lore.385268641175781376: Harbor workers were left scratching their heads this week when a Chinese cargo ship that was found drifting downriver without a crew, was towed into port.
Lore.385268643411345408:
The aging vessel hasn't been registered in the area for nearly 30 years, leaving locals wondering how it got here and why it was abandoned. No owner has come forward, and officials admit they are uncertain what can legally be done.


For now the ghost ship sits silent at the docks, drawing uneasy looks and late night stories from curious residents.
Lore.385269306937655296:
Silver Pines woke to heartbreaking news yesterday after two local actors were killed during a stunt accident at the Thelend Broadcasting lot. 
The tragedy has sparked a debate about the dangerous stunts featured in the recent Terminal Drive production.
Lore.385269309152247808: One staff member had previously spoken out, saying that the risky scenes the script writers are calling for are increasingly reckless and unneccesarily endangering the cast.
Lore.385278551103979520:
As neighbors argue over who should be held responsible, this reporters thoughts are with young child left behind.
The investigation remains ongoing.
